comparisons.name: calendar-edge-light
comparisons.description: Right edge of the Calendar event popover with both corners, hairline, rim, separators and shadow, over the capture's transparent margin, Aqua. The masks cover Calendar's colour pop-up button, which is the event's content, and the two places beside the popover's corners where the shadow of the Calendar window falls into the crop. No text is in the crop.

comparisons.name: calendar-arrow-light
comparisons.description: The arrow of the Calendar event popover on its left edge, Aqua. The mask covers Calendar's red current-time line. No text is in the crop.

comparisons.name: calendar-edge-dark
comparisons.description: Right edge of the Calendar event popover with both corners, outer line, rim, separators and shadow, over the capture's transparent margin, Dark Aqua. The mask covers Calendar's colour pop-up button. No text is in the crop.

comparisons.name: calendar-arrow-dark
comparisons.description: The arrow of the Calendar event popover on its left edge, Dark Aqua. No text is in the crop.

comparisons.name: arrow-up-light
comparisons.description: A popover below its anchor, Aqua: the arrow is filled and the panel starts where the arrow ends. No screenshot shows this side. The page beside the tip is checked in Dark Aqua only: in Aqua the arrow's shadow there is as light as its fill.

pixels.note: inside the arrow, 9 pt below its tip: the opaque popover fill (token, measured in Calendar)
the panel: the popover material over white, computed from the token

comparisons.name: arrow-up-dark
comparisons.description: A popover below its anchor, Dark Aqua: the arrow is turned to point up, is filled, and the panel starts where the arrow ends. No screenshot shows this side.

pixels.note: inside the arrow, 9 pt below its tip: the opaque popover fill (token, measured in Calendar)
the page 12 pt beside the tip, outside the arrow's side; inferred
the panel: the popover material over #1e1e1e, computed from the token
